draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I applied to the Software Engineer opening on the vision and robotics side at United Imaging Intelligence and wanted to reach out directly, since that team is exactly the intersection I have been building toward.

My background is hands on across computer vision and robotics on embedded hardware. I built a vision guided robotic arm that runs YOLO through TensorRT on a Jetson for real time detection and visual servoing, paired with depth sensing for reliable contact aware grasping. I also have research experience training deep learning segmentation models on medical imaging data, which lines up closely with the kind of clinical AI work your team does.

If you have a few minutes sometime, I would really value a short conversation about the team and where my background might fit in.
draft.hook_used: He leads Vision and Robotic Intelligence at UII (VP R&D), the exact domain of the role applied to, and is currently hiring on that team
